description: User-authorized campaign: each issue gets an isolated temporary worktree, failing reproduction, thorough diagnosis, written plan reviewed by an independent cold agent, TDD implementation, acceptance-criteria audit, and draft PR with long-form rationale/examples. title: Investigate, cold-review, and deliver fixes for GitHub issues #233–#239
